title: Frula Klan
wikitext:
Frula Klan [en: Flout Clan ] was one of the first, if not the FIRST, Serbian Quake Clans.
in those years it was still and underground club.
Later many of it's members founded the Quake 2 Clan Diedra Knight Guild [DKG].
